whyDifferent.heading: Why San Diego SEO Requires Industry-Specific Expertise
items: Healthcare & biotech content must meet Google's YMYL (Your Money Your Life) quality bar — accuracy, authoritative sourcing, and clear E-E-A-T signals are non-negotiable.
Defense contractors often serve B2G and enterprise B2B buyers with long procurement cycles, requiring authority content over quick-conversion landing pages.
Local professional services (law firms, financial advisors, real estate) compete heavily in the Google Map Pack and need consistent citations and review generation.
Tourism & hospitality businesses face seasonal search demand swings and need content built around trip-planning and booking-intent keywords, not just brand terms.

mistakes: Publishing thin healthcare content that fails E-E-A-T review. Google holds YMYL healthcare and medical content to a higher bar — pages without credentialed authorship or clear sourcing routinely get suppressed.
Missing schema markup on clinic and practice sites. Structured data for medical organizations, services, and reviews significantly improves eligibility for rich results and AI Overview citations.
Weak or inconsistent local citations. NAP (Name, Address, Phone) inconsistency across directories is one of the most common reasons San Diego local businesses underperform in the Map Pack.
No seasonal content strategy for hospitality. Tourism and hospitality businesses that don't plan content around seasonal booking windows miss the highest-intent search traffic of the year.
